run_make_gpt2_dataset: run the script to tokenize an OpenWebText shard into a GPT-2 .npy dataset file
tokenize_corpus_function: tokenize a JSON-lines corpus file using a GPT-2 tokenizer and save as a NumPy array
create_gpt2_dataset_from_shard: create a GPT-2 tokenized dataset from an OpenWebText shard by providing path and shard number
review_tokenize_corpus: review the tokenize_corpus function that processes JSON documents and converts text to uint16 token arrays
summarize_make_gpt2_dataset: summarize the make_gpt2_dataset script that reads JSON-lines shards and outputs tokenized NumPy files
